description: Arterial Drainage Scheme Embankments is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Office of Public Works. Abstract: This data shows Arterial Drainage Scheme (ADS) Embankments constructed under the Arterial Drainage Acts 1945 & 1995, that OPW has a statutory obligation to maintain. These are man made raised structures of natural materials, constructed to protect low lying ground from flooding (not properties). Coverage: Ireland. The portal files it under the publisher Office of Public Works. Its tags are drainage systems, embankment, flood embankments, hydraulic engineering. It offers 2 resource(s) in SHP, WMS. The portal shows 2021-08-31 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
